# gNMI Receiver

The gNMI receiver ingests streaming network telemetry from devices that expose a
[gNMI](https://github.com/openconfig/gnmi) interface. It subscribes to the device
(dial-in) and converts the streamed updates into OpenTelemetry metrics.
